Preserve reference matte painted gouache style and organ identity. Output landscape16:9 canvas, keep original 1672x941 aspect and composition anchors. This layer contains only 1 or 2 broad perimeter anatomical contours as a single layer, with a large completely transparent center and lower center for gameplay. REMOVE ALL blue water, water rays, bubbles, specks, haze, background wash, floor platforms, near framing, creatures and all props. All empty areas must have genuine zero-alpha transparency, no blue rectangle, no checker pattern. Keep far anatomy muted cool low contrast with soft internal shading but a clean external alpha edge. No bright top ledges that read as gameplay terrain, no cropped gameplay modules. Depict only the following far organ forms: One broad distant whale cranial plate enters from upper RIGHT, with a small compact rounded dense ear-bone bulla tucked near its right underside. Plate has diagonal old crack and muted pale blue-gray face with subtle porous texture. Ear bone is compact oval, absolutely NO giant spiral cochlea, no human skull face, jaw, eye socket, vertebral tunnel or ribs. Keep left two-thirds and bottom half mostly transparent. No near bone ledges, floor bridge or foreground. Remove all blue water around the bone.
